description: Logging improvement for the Python warehouse inventory service owned by the logistics team. The stock sync module (inventory_sync.py) logs every message at ERROR level regardless of severity, builds messages with string concatenation, hides unknown-SKU failures behind bare except clauses, and drops the order_id that reserve_stock receives so reservations cannot be traced. Refactor its logging to production standard: correct level per event (routine sync is INFO, per-SKU corrections DEBUG, unknown SKUs and rejected reservations WARNING), lazy %-style formatting, explicit narrow exception handling instead of bare except, sync summaries with updated/unknown counts, and warehouse_id/sku/order_id context on every message. Do not change stock arithmetic.
